snippet.title: Flame Hunter: Zhong Kui - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the legendary demon hunter in Flame Hunter: Zhong Kui, a myth-inspired action RPG where fast-paced hack-and-slash combat meets supernatural powers. Defeat monstrous enemies, morph into your foes to wield their abilities, and uncover the secrets of the Underworld in a world steeped in ancient magic.

👉 add it to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4550140/Flame_Hunter_Zhong_Kui/

🎮 main channel: https://www.youtube.com/@explorerdotgames

🌐 other platforms: beacons.ai @explorer.games

#FlameHunterZhongKui #ARPG #HackAndSlash
